title: Decision use cases
description: The decisions the portal's data can support. Deliberately small and concrete; each one is the seed of an analytical product rather than a marketing category.

concepts.definition: Detecting and anticipating agricultural and hydrological drought from vegetation, precipitation and water-deficit signals.
Allocating water and maintaining canal and drainage systems across irrigated districts.
Reducing exposure and loss from earthquakes, floods, mudflows and glacial-lake outbursts.
Choosing where to protect, connect or restore habitat, and finding gaps in the protected-area network.
Estimating stocks, emissions and sequestration potential in soils and forests.
Tracking salinity, productivity decline, bare-surface expansion and pasture overuse.
Understanding settlement growth, abandonment and pressure on irrigated land.
Balancing supply, demand and stress across basins and catchments.
